requirements.rule: Art. 58 c. 3: the net cap of the apprentice pay.

APPRENTICESHIP DURATIONS: the durations of the professionalizzante come from the accord of 17 April 2012 as amended in 2014, of which no signed or CNEL copy was found (only aggregator copies); the percentages of art. 58 are verified. Every apprentice run carries this limitation.
requirements.remediation: Read a signed copy of the accord of 17 April 2012 and its 2014 amendment.

requirements.rule: Artt. 160 c. 4 and 161 c. 6 (ipotesi of 5 July 2024, pp. 45-46): from 1 July 2024 the maternity, paternity and parental leave count 'ai fini dell'integrale maturazione e corresponsione' of the tredicesima, and maternity and paternity of the quattordicesima; the engine accrues every extra month in full during these leaves, as D.Lgs. 151/2001 art. 34 c. 5 does for the tredicesima. Not settled: the quattordicesima during the parental leave before 1 December 2027, which the renewal guarantees only from that date ('Solo dal 1° dicembre 2027'); the engine accrues it in full.
requirements.remediation: Read whether the parental leave reduces the quattordicesima before 1 December 2027 and, if it does, take its days out of the accrual.

requirements.rule: The caller-selected extra hourly table is encoded for the five levels and dated tranches printed on p. 44 of the 2024 renewal. Art. 155(1),(3) of the 2010 agreement gives priority to territorial bargaining and better conditions and requires a minimum four-hour service; the table is all-inclusive of extra months and TFR. Those precedence, minimum-service, and all-inclusive accrual treatments are not yet implemented.
requirements.remediation: Model territorial precedence, the four-hour service minimum and avoid separate extra-month and TFR accrual for all-inclusive rates.

requirements.rule: Art. 13 c. 10 (ipotesi 5 July 2024, pp. 11-12, read on the page images): the amounts of November 2027 (A and B 186, 1-3 158, 4-5 140, 6s-7 112) are parameters.equalisation_element. Approximated: the trigger, read from the second-level facts of 2026 where the text asks whether an integrative agreement was defined by 31 October 2026 after a platform was presented; the proportion to the days actually worked in 2026, counted in months of more than 15 days; the absorption of comma 8, which takes any individual or collective treatment granted after 1 July 2024, the engine deducting only the individual elements. Not modelled: the welfare alternative of comma 11, the crisis exemption of comma 13 and the territorial agreements of comma 14.
requirements.remediation: State the comma 10 condition and the days worked in 2026 as facts, take every treatment granted after 1 July 2024 into the absorption, and model commi 11, 13 and 14.

requirements.rule: Verbale of 30 November 2016 (CNEL 1537, scanned pp. 1-2): the relations established from 14 November 2016 reach the small-hotel paga base 'entro il 31 gennaio 2018', with lower tranches in November 2016 and August 2017 (and a lower extra/surroga table); the January 2018 column equals the April 2016 table of the 2014 renewal (A 2.196,97, 4 1.542,89), so from February 2018 the two cohorts are paid the same and the 2024 renewal sets one table for all. The ramp is not modelled: it concerns November 2016 to January 2018 only.
requirements.remediation: Model the cohort tables of November 2016 and August 2017 for a run of those months; nothing is owed from February 2018.

requirements.rule: Art. 145: the Quadri allowance is reduced by the worker's individual elements (absorbed_by_individual_excess), which the caller states as the treatments 'riconosciuti aziendalmente'. In the 13th and 14th the engine offsets it by the same monthly elements, also those paid only 12 times (IndividualElement.extra_months false); art. 145 does not say whether such an element absorbs the allowance in the extra months, so the 13th and 14th of a quadro with one may be understated.
requirements.remediation: Source whether an individual treatment paid on 12 months absorbs the art. 145 allowance in the 13th and 14th, and offset the extra months accordingly.

requirements.rule: SICKNESS (art. 228, 2010 text p. 184): the CCNL integrates up to a share of the net daily pay without saying how the net pay is computed; the engine grosses up the INPS indemnity by the worker's INPS rate, as for the Commercio file. For fixed-term and seasonal workers no integration is due past the end of the contract (c.2).
requirements.remediation: Model the net daily pay of art. 228 and the end of a fixed-term contract.
